llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The ScrapeInterval field in GlobalConfig needs to change from model.Duration to a new typed Duration with validation constraints. This change affects GlobalConfig which is embedded by Thanos, Mimir, and Grafana for configuring Prometheus-compatible scrape and evaluation intervals. Any existing code that assigns model.Duration values to ScrapeInterval will break and require updates.
